BiblicalUsage: Matri is the family of Benjamin from which Saul was taken to be king: when the tribe was brought near by families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken. It is the only place the name appears, at the very moment Israel gets the king it asked for.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the detail matters: God chose the king from a named family, in the open, by lot, so that no one could say Saul took the throne for himself.
